title: Evaluation of Mitochondrial Function
author: E. Dale Abel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7s8hnhw

steps.title: Prepare saponin‑permeabilized fibers
steps.instruction: Cut left‑ventricle cardiac muscle into pieces of 2–5 mg, permeabilize with 50 µg ml⁻¹ saponin at 4 °C in buffer A (7.23 mM K₂EGTA, 2.77 mM K₂CaEGTA, 6.56 mM MgCl₂, 20 mM imidazole, 0.5 mM DTT, 53.3 mM K‑methanesulfonate, 20 mM taurine, 5.3 mM Na₂ATP, 15 mM phosphocreatine, 3 mM KH₂PO₄, pH 7.1 adjusted at 25 °C). Wash twice for 10 min each in buffer B (7.23 mM K₂EGTA, 2.77 mM K₂CaEGTA, 1.38 mM MgCl₂, 20 mM imidazole, 0.5 mM DTT, 100 mM K‑methanesulfonate, 20 mM taurine, 3 mM KH₂PO₄, 2 mg ml⁻¹ BSA, pH 7.1 adjusted at 25 °C).

steps.title: Measure mitochondrial respiration
steps.instruction: Place a permeabilized fiber sample in 2 ml of buffer B at 25 °C with continuous stirring and an oxygen‑fluor probe. Add one of the following substrate mixes: (a) 5 mM glutamate + 2 mM malate; (b) 10 mM pyruvate + 5 mM malate; (c) 20 µM palmitoyl‑carnitine + 2 mM malate. Record oxygen consumption (solubility = 215 nmol O₂ ml⁻¹) and express as nmol O₂ min⁻¹ mg⁻¹ dry weight. Determine: State 2 (substrate only), State 3 (add 1 mM ADP), State 4 (add oligomycin 1 µg ml⁻¹). Calculate the respiratory control ratio (RC = State 3/State 4).

substeps.instruction: Add fiber to 2 ml buffer B, set temperature to 25 °C, start stirring and oxygen probe.
Introduce chosen substrate mix and allow equilibration (State 2).
Add 1 mM ADP to initiate State 3 and record rate.
Add oligomycin to a final concentration of 1 µg ml⁻¹ to achieve State 4 and record rate.
Compute RC ratio as State 3 divided by State 4.

steps.title: Determine ATP concentration
steps.instruction: Measure ATP in the fiber preparation by bioluminescence using the luciferin/luciferase reaction according to the Enliten ATP assay system (Promega, Madison, WI) as described in reference 3.

steps.title: Isolate cardiac mitochondria
steps.instruction: Mince hearts and homogenize on ice in 10 % (wt/v) isolation buffer (20 mM HEPES, pH 7.4; 140 mM KCl; 10 mM EDTA; 5 mM MgCl₂) supplemented with 2–4 mg nagarse. Centrifuge at 500 g for 10 min; discard pellet. Centrifuge supernatant at 9 000 g for 35 min. Wash the resulting pellet with isolation buffer lacking nagarse and resuspend in 80 µl isolation buffer. Determine protein concentration with the Micro BCA protein assay kit (Pierce).

steps.title: Assay total CPT activity
steps.instruction: Incubate ~200 µg isolated mitochondria in 1 ml CPT reaction buffer (20 mM HEPES, 1 mM EGTA, 220 mM sucrose, 40 mM KCl, 0.1 mM DTNB, 1.3 mg ml⁻¹ BSA, 40 µM palmitoyl‑CoA, pH 7.4) at 25 °C. Initiate the reaction by adding 1 mM carnitine (baseline omitted) and monitor absorbance at 412 nm for 4 min with an Ultraspec 3000 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Assay CPT II activity
steps.instruction: Perform the same reaction as total CPT but include 10 µM malonyl‑CoA to inhibit CPT I. Monitor at 412 nm for 4 min as above.

steps.title: Calculate CPT I activity
steps.instruction: Subtract CPT II activity from total CPT activity to obtain CPT I activity.

steps.title: Assay citrate synthase activity
steps.instruction: Homogenize ~10 mg frozen heart pieces in 20 % (wt/v) homogenization buffer (20 mM HEPES, 10 mM EDTA, pH 7.4) on ice. Freeze homogenates for 1 h, then dilute 1:10. Prepare 1 ml reaction buffer (20 mM HEPES, 1 mM EGTA, 220 mM sucrose, 40 mM KCl, 0.1 mM DTNB, 0.1 mM acetyl‑CoA, pH 7.4) at 25 °C. Start the reaction by adding 0.05 mM oxaloacetate (baseline omitted) and monitor absorbance at 412 nm for 3 min with an Ultraspec 3000.

steps.title: Assay β‑hydroxyacyl‑CoA dehydrogenase
steps.instruction: Use the same homogenates as for citrate synthase, diluted 1:4. Prepare 1 ml reaction buffer (20 mM HEPES, 1 mM EGTA, 1 mM KCN, 0.15 mM NADH, pH 7.4) at 25 °C. Initiate the reaction by adding 0.1 mM acetoacetyl‑CoA (baseline omitted) and record absorbance at 340 nm for 4 min using an Ultraspec 3000.
